steps.label: Create a client and a project
steps.sentence: Every project belongs to a Bloomreach account (client); you already have both.

steps.label: Import the data mapping
steps.sentence: Paste Bloomreach's data-mapping.json to bring in your events, properties and catalogs.

steps.label: Import expiration settings
steps.sentence: Paste expiration-settings.json so property and event retention shows up on the cards.

steps.label: Review property types
steps.sentence: Resolve any open type mismatch findings so property types match what Bloomreach expects.

steps.label: Import Data Manager files
steps.sentence: Import both data-manager-customers.json and data-manager-events.json to compare against the live Data Manager.

steps.label: Capture observations
steps.sentence: Record a QA run with real customer events so the tool can compare definitions against reality.

steps.label: Run a comparison
steps.sentence: Run the comparisons to surface gaps between the definition, the mapping and what was observed.

steps.label: Instantiate a use case
steps.sentence: Pick a template from the use case library and instantiate it against your events and properties.

steps.label: Create a share link
steps.sentence: Generate a read-only link so the client can see the documentation without a login.
